```{r}
# Reference lists

  select(Code, Description) %>%
  mutate(Code = as.numeric(Code))
## Area - region (normal path gives back xml version)

Area <- read.csv(url, header = TRUE)
### Fix the extra space in rcg region code
Area <- mutate(Area, Code = ifelse(Code %in% "NSEA                                    " , "NSEA",

  select(AreaCode, Code)
```

```{r}
# Read data 
CL <- fread("./CommercialLanding.csv", quote = "")  
CE <- fread("./CommercialEffort.csv", quote="")

# Filter for multi_years
CL <- filter(CL, CLyear %in% multi_years)
CE <- filter(CE, CEyear %in% multi_years)

```

```{r}
# Keep only area 27
CL <- filter(CL, substr(CLarea, 1, 2) == "27")
CE <- filter(CE, substr(CEarea, 1, 2) == "27")

# Assign RCG region
CL <- left_join(CL, Area, by = c("CLarea" = "AreaCode"))
CL <- filter(CL, !is.na(Code))  # remove NAs
CE <- left_join(CE, Area, by = c("CEarea" = "AreaCode"))
CE <- filter(CE, !is.na(Code))

#table(CE$Code, useNA = "always") # No NA's
#table(CL$Code, useNA = "always") # No NA's
```

```{r}
# Merge for scientific name 
CL <- left_join(CL, ScienName, by = c("CLspeciesCode" = "Code"))
```

```{r}
# Process

## Year string 
CL$CLyear <- as.character(CL$CLyear)
CE$CEyear <- as.character(CE$CEyear)

## Month factors 
CL$CLmonth <- factor(CL$CLmonth, levels = as.character(c(1:12)))
CE$CEmonth <- factor(CE$CEmonth, levels = as.character(c(1:12)))

## Quarter factors 
CL$CLquarter <- factor(CL$CLquarter, levels = as.character(c(1:4)))
CE$CEquarter <- factor(CE$CEquarter, levels = as.character(c(1:4)))

## Vessel length factors 
CL$CLvesLenCat <- factor(CL$CLvesselLengthCategory, levels = c("VL0006","VL0608", "VL0810", "VL1012", "VL1215", "VL1518", "VL1824", "VL2440", "VL40XX", "NK"))
CE$CEvesLenCat <- factor(CE$CEvesselLengthCategory, levels = c("VL0006","VL0608", "VL0810", "VL1012", "VL1215", "VL1518", "VL1824", "VL2440", "VL40XX", "NK"))

## Country factors 
CL$CLvesselFlagCountry <- factor(CL$CLvesselFlagCountry, levels = sort(unique(CL$CLvesselFlagCountry)))
CE$CEvesselFlagCountry <- factor(CE$CEvesselFlagCountry, levels = sort(unique(CE$CEvesselFlagCountry)))


## Get metier lvl 4 
CL <- mutate(CL, CLmetier4 = str_extract(CLmetier6, "[^_]+"))
CE <- mutate(CE, CEmetier4 = str_extract(CEmetier6, "[^_]+"))

## Get metier lvl 5 
CL <- mutate(CL, CLmetier5 = str_extract(CLmetier6,  "[^_]*_[^_]*"))
CE <- mutate(CE, CEmetier5 = str_extract(CEmetier6,  "[^_]*_[^_]*"))


# Weight kg to t 
CL <- mutate(CL, CLscientificWeight = round(CLscientificWeight/1000, digits = 2))

# Filter CatchCategory == Landings
CL <- filter(CL, CLcatchCategory %in% "Lan")

```

```{r r yearly-summaries}

### Build yearly & 3‑year summaries
CL_byYear <- CLAREA |>
  group_by(CLyear, CLquarter, CLmetier4, CLmetier5, CLmetier6,
           CLvesselFlagCountry, CLvesLenCat, Description) |>
  summarise(scientificWeight = sum(CLscientificWeight, na.rm = TRUE),
            landingsValue    = sum(as.numeric(CLlandingsValue), na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")

CE_byYear <- CEAREA |>
  group_by(CEyear, CEmetier4, CEmetier5, CEmetier6,
           CEvesselFlagCountry, CEvesLenCat,
           CEquarter, CEstatisticalRectangle) |>
  summarise(scientificDaysAtSea = sum(CEscientificDaysAtSea, na.rm = TRUE),
            numberOfTrips       = sum(CEnumberOfFractionalTrips, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")

# 3‑year collapsed ------------------------------------------------------------
CL_3yr <- CL_byYear |>
  group_by(CLmetier4, CLmetier5, CLmetier6) |>
  summarise(scientificWeight = sum(scientificWeight),
            landingsValue    = sum(landingsValue), .groups = "drop")

CE_3yr <- CE_byYear |>
  group_by(CEmetier4, CEmetier5, CEmetier6) |>
  summarise(scientificDaysAtSea = sum(scientificDaysAtSea),
            numberOfTrips       = sum(numberOfTrips), .groups = "drop")

```

```{r top10-driver}

driver_tbl <- "effort"     # "effort" = scientificDaysAtSea  |
                           # "weight" = scientificWeight
driver_n   <- 10           # how many metiers to keep per level
## ------------------------------------------------------------------

if (driver_tbl == "effort") {
  drv_tbl      <- CE_3yr
  drv_col      <- "scientificDaysAtSea"
  driver_label <- "scientific fishing days"
  met4 <- "CEmetier4" ;  met5 <- "CEmetier5" ;  met6 <- "CEmetier6"
} else {
  drv_tbl      <- CL_3yr
  drv_col      <- "scientificWeight"
  driver_label <- "scientific landed weight"
  met4 <- "CLmetier4" ;  met5 <- "CLmetier5" ;  met6 <- "CLmetier6"
}

## helper ----------------------------------------------------------------------
get_topN <- function(tbl, met, n = driver_n){
  tbl |>
    group_by(.data[[met]]) |>
    summarise(total = sum(.data[[drv_col]], na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
    slice_max(total, n = n) |>
    pull(.data[[met]])
}

## compute the three driver lists ---------------------------------------------
top10_L4 <- get_topN(drv_tbl, met4)
top10_L5 <- get_topN(drv_tbl, met5)
top10_L6 <- get_topN(drv_tbl, met6)

## FILTER the yearly & 3-year tables *once*  -----------------------------------
CL_byYear_L4 <- CL_byYear |> filter(CLmetier4 %in% top10_L4)
CL_byYear_L5 <- CL_byYear |> filter(CLmetier5 %in% top10_L5)
CL_byYear_L6 <- CL_byYear |> filter(CLmetier6 %in% top10_L6)

CE_byYear_L4 <- CE_byYear |> filter(CEmetier4 %in% top10_L4)
CE_byYear_L5 <- CE_byYear |> filter(CEmetier5 %in% top10_L5)
CE_byYear_L6 <- CE_byYear |> filter(CEmetier6 %in% top10_L6)

CL_3yr_L4 <- CL_3yr |> filter(CLmetier4 %in% top10_L4)
CL_3yr_L5 <- CL_3yr |> filter(CLmetier5 %in% top10_L5)
CL_3yr_L6 <- CL_3yr |> filter(CLmetier6 %in% top10_L6)

CE_3yr_L4 <- CE_3yr |> filter(CEmetier4 %in% top10_L4)
CE_3yr_L5 <- CE_3yr |> filter(CEmetier5 %in% top10_L5)
CE_3yr_L6 <- CE_3yr |> filter(CEmetier6 %in% top10_L6)

```

```{r, results='asis'}

pandoc.header("Executive Summary", level = 1)

pandoc.p(glue::glue("
This report provides an overview of fishing activity in **{rrr}** over {paste(multi_years, collapse = '–')}, 
drawing on **Commercial Landings** (CL) and **Commercial Effort** (CE) data submitted to the RDBES in 2025.  
We consider only **landings** (catch category `'Lan'`) and express landings in scientific weight (t) and value (€), 
and effort as scientific fishing days and number of trips, broken down by flag-state and vessel size class.

To characterise dominant metiers at each level, we apply a Top-10 rule, independently at each tier:

- **Level 4:** the ten L4 gears with the highest cumulative {driver_label}.  
- **Level 5:** the ten L5 variants with the highest cumulative {driver_label}.  
- **Level 6:** the ten L6 mesh-sizes with the highest cumulative {driver_label}.  

Subsequent sections visualise whole-fleet annual and quarterly trends, followed by metier-level time series and rankings for the Top 10 at Levels 4–6.
"))


```

```{r}

## ── L4: build Δ table ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
quick_delta_L4 <- function(df, yr_col, met_col, val_col, y1="2021", y2="2024") {
  yr  <- enquo(yr_col)
  met <- enquo(met_col)
  val <- enquo(val_col)

  df %>%
    filter(!!yr %in% c(y1,y2), !!met %in% top10_L4) %>%
    group_by(!!yr, !!met) %>%
    summarise(total = sum(!!val, na.rm=TRUE), .groups="drop") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from  = !!yr,
                values_from = total,
                names_prefix = "Year_") %>%
    mutate(
  Delta    = .data[[paste0("Year_", y2)]] - .data[[paste0("Year_", y1)]],
  PctDelta = 100 * Delta / .data[[paste0("Year_", y1)]]
) %>%
    select(-starts_with("Year_")) %>%          # <<< drop the duplicate Year_ cols here
    rename(CLmetier4 = !!met)
}

## ── L4: rank + merge Δ ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
rank_plus_delta_L4 <- function(data, yr_col, met_col, val_col, delta_tbl, metric_nm) {
  yr_str  <- rlang::as_name(enquo(yr_col))
  met_str <- rlang::as_name(enquo(met_col))
  val_sym <- enquo(val_col)

  data %>%
    filter(.data[[met_str]] %in% top10_L4) %>%
    group_by(.data[[yr_str]], .data[[met_str]]) %>%
    summarise(total = sum(!!val_sym, na.rm=TRUE), .groups="drop") %>%
    group_by(.data[[yr_str]]) %>%
    mutate(Rank = dense_rank(desc(total))) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      id_cols    = all_of(met_str),
      names_from = all_of(yr_str),
      values_from = c(total, Rank),
      names_glue = paste0("{.value}_{", yr_str, "}")
    ) %>%
    rename(CLmetier4 = all_of(met_str)) %>%
    setNames(gsub("^total_", paste0(metric_nm, "_"), names(.))) %>%
    left_join(delta_tbl, by = "CLmetier4") %>%
    arrange(desc(.data[[paste0(metric_nm, "_2024")]]))
}

diff_trips_L5  <- quick_delta_L5(CE_byYear_L5, CEyear, CEmetier5,

rank_weight_L5 <- rank_plus_delta_L5(CL_byYear_L5, CLyear, CLmetier5,
                                  scientificWeight, diff_weight_L5,
                                  "TotWeight")

rank_value_L5  <- rank_plus_delta_L5(CL_byYear_L5, CLyear, CLmetier5,
                                  landingsValue,    diff_value_L5,
                                  "TotValue")

rank_days_L5   <- rank_plus_delta_L5(CE_byYear_L5, CEyear, CEmetier5,
                                  scientificDaysAtSea, diff_days_L5,
                                  "TotDays")

rank_trips_L5  <- rank_plus_delta_L5(CE_byYear_L5, CEyear, CEmetier5,
                                  numberOfTrips,    diff_trips_L5,
                                  "TotTrips")

## ───── Level 6 ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

diff_weight_L6 <- quick_delta_L6(CL_byYear_L6, CLyear, CLmetier6,
                              scientificWeight)

diff_value_L6  <- quick_delta_L6(CL_byYear_L6, CLyear, CLmetier6,
                              landingsValue)

diff_days_L6   <- quick_delta_L6(CE_byYear_L6, CEyear, CEmetier6,
                              scientificDaysAtSea)

diff_trips_L6  <- quick_delta_L6(CE_byYear_L6, CEyear, CEmetier6,
                              numberOfTrips)

rank_weight_L6 <- rank_plus_delta_L6(CL_byYear_L6, CLyear, CLmetier6,
                                  scientificWeight, diff_weight_L6,
                                  "TotWeight")

rank_value_L6  <- rank_plus_delta_L6(CL_byYear_L6, CLyear, CLmetier6,
                                  landingsValue,    diff_value_L6,
                                  "TotValue")

rank_days_L6   <- rank_plus_delta_L6(CE_byYear_L6, CEyear, CEmetier6,
                                  scientificDaysAtSea, diff_days_L6,
                                  "TotDays")

rank_trips_L6  <- rank_plus_delta_L6(CE_byYear_L6, CEyear, CEmetier6,
                                  numberOfTrips,    diff_trips_L6,
                                  "TotTrips")
```

```{r, results='asis'}
pandoc.header("Trends top 10 metier level 4", level=1)
pandoc.p(glue::glue(
  "Over {paste(multi_years, collapse = '–')}, we ranked the Top-{driver_n} Level-4 gears by total {driver_label}. ",
  "The four plots below display, for each of these metiers and by year, their landed weight, landed value, total fishing days and number of trips, ",
  "allowing to track increases or declines across metrics and compare performance year-to-year."
))

pandoc.header("Annual variation top 10 metier level 4", level=2)

p1 <- ggplot(CL_year_topL4, aes(reorder(CLmetier4, -TotWeight), TotWeight, fill = CLyear)) +
        geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") + theme_minimal() +
        labs(x = "Metier L4", y = "Weight (t)", title = "Landed weight") +
        theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

p2 <- ggplot(CL_year_topL4, aes(reorder(CLmetier4, -TotValue),  TotValue,  fill = CLyear)) +
        geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") + theme_minimal() +
        labs(x = "Metier L4", y = "Value (€)", title = "Landed value (€)") +
        theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

p3 <- ggplot(CE_year_topL4, aes(reorder(CEmetier4, -TotDays),  TotDays,  fill = CEyear)) +
        geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") + theme_minimal() +
        labs(x = "Metier L4", y = "Days at sea", title = "Fishing days") +
        theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

p4 <- ggplot(CE_year_topL4, aes(reorder(CEmetier4, -TotTrips), TotTrips, fill = CEyear)) +
        geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") + theme_minimal() +
        labs(x = "Metier L4", y = "Trips", title = "Trips") +
        theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

l <- ggarrange(p1, p2, p3, p4, ncol = 2, nrow = 2)
print(l)
```
